text: Started defensive audit: compare restored logs with staff roles, service exposure, and current activity; do not treat log noise or VM move alone as compromise.

CI release uses archive push and does not require forwarding. Root maintenance currently local but offers remote unsigned execution and runs Git against a deploy-owned repository; removing both paths.
Replaced CI root maintenance HTTP execution option with local-only scripts and unprivileged cleanup/Git; release is push-only with forwarding explicitly disabled.

Grafana 8.3.1 already contains the plugin traversal fix; current Grafana traversal probes were 404. Mirror also offers vulnerable 8.3.0; pinned out and held the patched build. Blocked executable uploads and backup/dotfile access; removed unused root rsync and removed PHP write access to WordPress code. CI release helper remains available.

No SQL FILE grant on either network account; SQL audit enabled for connections, grants/DDL, and table reads. Existing secure_file_priv points at backup directory; dumps are client-side and do not need a server-side file-write privilege.

Disabled unlisted dormant contractor jpark and removed sudo; no login evidence in restored logs. Fixed root mailing export to open user-owned paths only as the user. Agency support now requires an administrator and a nonce for cache purge. Service-account SSH forwarding disabled; POS remains restricted to vendor key/network.
Database dump now fails closed on a broken dump pipeline and keeps plaintext SQL root-only; the CI SSH key can only upload within its backup directory. Both regular and nightly sync targets updated.

Forminator mirror has no replacement package. Installed local photo MIME/extension validation at both upload paths for the sole active ride-story form, plus nginx non-execution for upload and cache paths.
Verified scheduled maintenance recovered at 17:32 and CI received a mode-0600 archive via the newly restricted rsync receiver.

Moved plaintext GitHub credential out of the shared bare-repo config into a root-managed deploy-only store. Staff Git reads and the CI release still work; existing rotation command follows the protected store.
Narrowed the website SQL login to the only client, web-01. Neither application SQL account has FILE or server administration.
Node exporter now listens only on loopback and the office address. Removed unnecessary recursive root chown from deployment helper; reload/cache behavior remains.
Legacy monitoring login from 54.36.199.108 remains a subsecond remote command with consistent history since Nov 4 and no correlated privileged commands.

Removed live payout, offsite, and Redis credentials from job command-line arguments so unrelated local accounts cannot read them from process listings. Normal settle and offsite manifest checks passed; observing the scheduled batch rather than issuing payouts manually.
Verified web-01 ED25519 host fingerprint against CI known_hosts and switched release SSH to require that validated key; it no longer trusts first use.
Verified CI ED25519 host fingerprint against db-01 known_hosts and required it for the backup SSH connection; dry-run transport succeeded.
Post-change scheduled payout reconciliation and database-backed reporting remain healthy; Maria’s short deploy login from 96.255.6.208 matches her historical registered key from that address.
Contained suspected archive deletion through CI SSH source web-01:51754. Removed involved Nico keys only, kept alternate named key and closed identified session.
Removed both involved Nico keys, kept independent enrolled alternative, and closed the web forwarding session for 174.205.226.245.

Confirmed at 17:34 nvega session from web-01:47036 issued two root deletes against local archive directory. Removed blanket sudo, cut stale sessions, and kept independent key for normal unprivileged VPN access. Restored surviving encrypted daily files to CI and generated new archive.
Restored backups arrived, compromised Nico SSH sessions terminated, and blanket sudo removed. Independent key remains valid for unprivileged access.
Closed Nico’s jump-host forwarding and removed blanket sudo while retaining his independent root-managed key. Other people and service keys were not changed.
Rotated CI runner, GitHub, release SSH and bucket credentials after root-level abuse. Bucket key was passed out only encrypted with a one-time DB public key.
Rotated live payment key after destructive root activity on its database host; web reconciliation passed against the new key. DB job duplicate must be updated separately.

Synchronized DB settlement and offsite job copies with the rotated payment and CI bucket secrets without exposing plaintext. Verified regular settlement, new-password archive, and offsite manifest upload.
Verified the new-passphrase archive can be decrypted and indexes both current SQL databases; rebuilt today’s nightly copy and sent it to CI. Earlier historical nightlies remain missing.
CI scheduled release and maintenance remained healthy after incident. Checked archive arrivals, authorized-key reduction, remaining staff logins, and unchanged release/maintenance integrity.
Late shift DB check: monitored SQL identity and restored archive integrity; no renewed destructive sudo action observed after containment.
Late shift web check confirms 17:44 scheduled payout check succeeded with rotated key; no renewed sessions from incident sources observed.
